text_block_list.text:
While walking through the school grounds, I saw Symboli Kris S
and Tanino Gimlet talking. And a little further off—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... w-what should I do...?
choice_data_list: Rob Roy? What are you up to?
Rob Roy? What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah...!! T-Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, Kris S-san and
Gimlet-san were talking about heroes, and—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I am very interested in this topic, but barging into your conversation out of nowhere feels... ugh.
—Geez, what are you moping around for?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah-wah...!! Sweep-san!!!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you supposed to be a hero?
Then just go out there and own it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right? Come on, we're doing this fair and square!!
Try and keep up!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What?!
P-Please wait...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...!? I-I'm so sorry for bursting in like this!!
Um, for interrupting your conversation--!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, should the Valkyries come to call,
I shall welcome them at any time."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "I was just talking about the tale where Siegfried slayed the dragon with the legendary sword Balmung."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...!! The battle against Fafnir!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hoh, clever. —That is the optimal solution.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...That look on your face. It seems
you also know that hero's weakness.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, I know!!!!
Siegfried's weak point is his back!!!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Siegfried slew the dragon
and bathed in its blood!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"With this, he attained an immortal body—
except for his back!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kuhahaha!! Good, that's exactly right!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: “Immortal...!? Does this mean magic is involved in this!?”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "That hero remained unaware only of the linden leaf stuck to his back... and so, by the narrowest of margins, fell just short of true immortality—!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the hero was not perfect!!
A decisive flaw!! An unbalanced strength!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But one could say it is precisely his weaknesses that make him a hero!
For if he were perfect, no story would have ever been spun!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "Precisely! Fuhahaha!! A kindred spirit!! It seems your mind is aligned with mine!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, tell me too~!
Magic's gotta be involved somehow!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hoh, so the young maiden seeks Odin's wisdom, does she? That, too, is fine.
Sweep Tosho joined the conversation with Zenno Rob Roy and Tanino Gimlet, making things even more lively.

Beside me, Symboli Kris S was also
gently watching over everyone.
choice_data_list: (Looks like the atmosphere turned out nice.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...!
You waited for me... I'm so sorry!
choice_data_list: Looks like you've become good friends, huh.
Looks like you've become good friends, huh?
That was so exciting, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...!
You waited for me... I'm so sorry!
choice_data_list: Looks like you've become good friends, huh.
Looks like you've become good friends, huh?
That was so exciting, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Heheh, well of course!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy is going to become a hero on par with the Great Witch.
This much is only natural! Isn't that right, Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... while that is true,
I'm still inexperienced compared to my seniors—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then isn't that just perfect!
You're a hero precisely because you have weaknesses—
you just said so yourself!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...! You're right, that was it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, as long as you understand♪
So next time, speak up yourself!
Loud and proud, like a true hero!
The Trainer told her that from now on, they could become even closer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
B-But, I really shouldn't cause
trouble for our upperclassmen—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...There are no issues.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Kris S-san...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really okay like that...?
......If so, I'd like to talk with them again.
